samples.summary: Combined `{ name, parentId }` PATCH semantics now pinned by tests but not recorded in the design docs
samples.evidence: The delta adds two tests that fix a contract the docs don't state: `renames and moves in a single write` and `refuses a rename bundled with a move a plain member may not make` (packages/backend/src/api/v1/folders.controller.spec.ts:231-252). docs/design/rest-api.md:492 describes the route only as "Rename ({ name }) or move ({ parentId })", and workspace-folders.md:126 likewise splits the two (`name` any member, `parentId` manager-gated) without saying what happens when one body carries both — i.e. that a refused move takes the rename down with it, all-or-nothing. Behaviour matches the web surface (packages/backend/src/folder/folder.controller.ts:85-103), so nothing diverges; only the written contract is silent. A one-line note in §5.8 would close it.
